reservation: maintainer standing exclusive grant until revoked, reaffirmed by the instruction to complete WP-749
daemon: unmodified committed production source; one identical binary for both arms
runner: identical binary with bounded preallocated raw samples; no daemon correlation or writer observers
gate: Unchanged acknowledgement latency and write gate; throughput disclosed separately; no numerical allowance or automatic pass
limits: one fixed-order pair does not calibrate a latency noise band
warmup included in writer, checkpoint and archive counters; raw latencies measured-only
no subtraction or reattribution of historical samples
